items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I'm not sure, I think the band was Paul Whiteman I believe, yeah.

ctx.x: But anyway, he picked up his baton and he did a "Stardust" concert arrangement a la Paul Whiteman and then they put those instruments away and got out their others, and really swung from then on. And of course they brought some of the acts along with them from Connie's Hot Chocolates, from the revue and it was quite a thing. This
